zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: 六项截图工作流与更可靠的标注
changes: 标注只在明确拖动后落笔，单击和轻微手抖不再留下红点，也不会污染撤销、重做记录
新增可编辑原稿、长图整理、步骤文档、结构化 OCR、标尺和区域短录屏
改进历史清理、快捷键恢复与截图结果操作，裁剪和旋转保留已有标注的视觉效果
所有 OCR 默认在本机处理，短录屏为最长 60 秒的无声 H.264 MP4
提供 Apple Silicon 与 Intel 通用版本，应用和 DMG 通过 Apple 公证，Sparkle 更新包带有签名

en.label: Latest
en.title: Six capture workflows and more reliable annotations
changes: Annotations begin only after an intentional drag, so clicks and small pointer jitter leave no stray dots or undo/redo entries.
Added editable drafts, long-image editing, step guides, structured OCR, ruler annotations, and short region recording.
Improved history cleanup, shortcut restoration, and capture-result actions while preserving annotation appearance through crop and rotation.
OCR remains on-device by default, and short recordings are silent H.264 MP4 files limited to 60 seconds.
Includes Apple Silicon and Intel support, an Apple-notarized app and DMG, and a signed Sparkle update package.
